method: Inspected all 77 contact sheets (front/threequarter/left/right x 8 phases, 16 for kb-getup) from docs/animation-review/6fb462ffc0ed/sheets and opened ~30 native 480x480 frames for hands, grips, occlusion, framing and contacts. Read figure.ts, hand-model.ts, kettlebell-model.ts, equipment-model.ts, figure-viewer.tsx, design/visual-tokens.json and src/constants/theme.ts. Used geometry.json clearances and computed from each clip JSON: per-frame joint speed, one-frame spikes, loop-seam step/acceleration, floor penetration and pairwise differences between similar clips. Real-time playback was NOT available: timing, pacing and loop seam are judged from duration and per-frame joint data only; the app's default per-clip camera (clip 'view') was not captured, so views were judged as the four fixed captures; PSX mode not reviewed.

kb-swing.summary: Hinge, float to chest height and hike read clearly in left/right/threequarter; two-hand grip on the handle is legible. Fast 1.43 s loop is plausible for a swing.

defects.issue: At the hike the bell is hidden between/behind the near thigh and the forearms sink 16 mm into the thighs (geometry forearm_l/r vs thigh -0.016 m).
defects.fix: Carry the hike path 3-4 cm wider/higher between the thighs or open the knees slightly so forearms and bell clear the thigh hulls.

defects.issue: Iron bell #55534e is a dark low-contrast blob on the #0b0b0a stage at phone size.
defects.fix: Lift the iron colour a step (about #6a675f) or strengthen the rim light so the bell silhouette separates from the stage.

kb-deadlift.summary: Clear hinge with bell between the feet in every view; handle grip reads; floor contact at the bottom is visible.

defects.issue: Upper arms pass 16.5 mm into the thighs at the bottom (geometry upper_arm vs thigh -0.0165 m).
defects.fix: Hang the arms a little more vertical/inside the knees at the bottom, or narrow the upper-arm radius near the shoulder.

goblet-squat.summary: Bell held at the chest by the horns, squat reads well from all four views; clean silhouette.

defects.issue: At depth the bell and both forearms overlap the chest into one dark mass; elbows touch the thighs (-1 mm).
defects.fix: Hold the bell 2-3 cm further forward at depth so the elbow-to-knee gap stays visible.

defects.fix: Seat the bell slightly outside the forearm (toward the lateral side) and keep the wrist/hand visible above the handle; or bias the default camera so the rack arm is near.

defects.issue: Forearm passes 14 mm into the thigh on the back-swing (geometry forearm_l vs thigh -0.0137).
defects.fix: Widen or raise the back-swing arc so the forearm clears the thigh.

defects.issue: Bell is far-side and sits near the top margin (about 40 px) at lockout; acceptable but tight.
defects.fix: Keep the current framing margin; no change required.

defects.issue: Turnover phase compresses bell, hand and head into one cluster.

defects.fix: Bias the default view to show the bent elbow from the side, or move the assisting hand to the near side.

cross-body-shoulder.summary: Arm across the chest reads in front/threequarter but framing is off.

defects.issue: Rest pose sits at the right edge with the back of the shoulder clipped; the frame is centred on bounds that include the extended arm.
defects.fix: Centre the upper-body crop on the torso, not the arm's swept bounds, and add margin.

defects.issue: Arm releases at 5.7 m/s (189 mm/frame).
defects.fix: Slow and ease the release.

behind-back-clasp.summary: Clasp and lift read in left/right profiles.

defects.issue: Clasped hands hidden behind the body.
defects.fix: Inherent; side default already.

neck-extension.summary: Upper-body crop makes the look-up obvious in side and threequarter.

neck-flexion.summary: Chin-to-chest reads clearly in side and threequarter.

side-neck.summary: Ear-to-shoulder alternation reads in front and threequarter.

shoulder-circle.summary: Shoulder roll is barely perceptible at phone size.

defects.issue: Only the shirt hull deforms slightly; the circular path of the shoulders cannot be read in any view (max 7 mm/frame).
defects.fix: Exaggerate elevation/retraction, let the arms ride with the shoulders, and add a visible collarbone/shoulder cap.

defects.issue: Crop (cropBelow 0.45) cuts the shoes at the bottom edge and slices the floor disc.
defects.fix: Either show the full feet or crop clearly at mid-shin.

defects.issue: Arms lower at ~6 m/s (210 mm/frame).
defects.fix: Ease the lowering over ~0.5 s.

torso-extension.summary: Hands-on-hips back lean reads in side views; the rigid torso limits the arch.

defects.issue: Extension shows as a stiff lean from the hips.
defects.fix: A mid-spine bend would make the lumbar extension readable.

oblique-twist.summary: Trunk rotation with clasped hands is subtle in standard views.

defects.issue: Legs swap near/far shade as the torso rotates though they don't move.
defects.fix: Shade each limb from its own depth.

defects.issue: Rotation reads only through the shirt; amplitude is small.
defects.fix: Increase rotation and let the head follow.

chest-expansions.summary: Open-and-cross arms read clearly in front and threequarter.

defects.issue: Crossed forearms merge into the shirt.
defects.fix: Cross a little lower/forward.

punches.summary: Jab and cross extension reads in side views.

defects.issue: Guard hides the face and punches come straight at the camera.
defects.fix: Inherent; default az 75.

defects.issue: Rear toe sits 39 mm below the floor every frame.
defects.fix: Clamp the rear foot to the floor.
